description: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 in extra time to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup, ending Lionel Messi's bid for a second consecutive title as Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in the 106th minute at MetLife Stadium.

faqs.answer: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. It is Spain's second World Cup title, their first since 2010.
faqs.question: Who won the 2026 FIFA World Cup?

faqs.answer: Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in the 106th minute of extra time, finishing from 8 yards after Nico Williams headed the ball back across goal.
faqs.question: Who scored the winning goal in the 2026 World Cup final?

faqs.answer: At 39 years old, Messi has not confirmed his international retirement, but the match is widely expected to be his final World Cup appearance. He was awarded the Silver Ball as the tournament's second-best player.
faqs.question: Was this Lionel Messi's last World Cup?

faqs.answer: Enzo Fernández received a second yellow card in stoppage time at the end of regulation for a late challenge on Spain's Pau Cubarsí, reducing Argentina to 10 players for all of extra time.
faqs.question: Why was Argentina down to 10 men?

faqs.answer: Rodri won the Golden Ball (best player), Pau Cubarsí won the Young Player award, Unai Simón won the Golden Glove (best goalkeeper), and Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot (top scorer with 10 goals).
faqs.question: Who won individual awards at the 2026 World Cup?

leadParagraph: Spain claimed their second FIFA World Cup title with a 1-0 extra-time victory over defending champions Argentina at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal in the 106th minute after Spain dominated the match from the opening whistle, holding Argentina to just two shots in 120 minutes. The defeat likely marks the end of Lionel Messi's World Cup career.
location: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey
